headline: Claude Code 2.1.319 and Antigravity CLI 1.5.3 fix security holes; headless runs now exit non-zero when refused or cut short.

themes.title: Permission and sandbox holes closed
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.319 closes a Bash permission bypass where a crafted environment prefix could hide part of a command, and a sandbox escape when creating a worktree ([2.1.319](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.3 fixes a terminal sandbox issue where a sandboxed command could change environment state that later persistent terminal commands loaded ([1.5.3](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.3)).
themes.so_what: update Claude Code to 2.1.319 and Antigravity CLI to 1.5.3 or later.

themes.title: Scripts get clearer failure signals, and new denials
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.319 makes `claude -p` exit 1 when auto mode refuses actions, where it used to exit 0 ([2.1.319](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.0 exits with code `3` when `--print-timeout` cuts a run short ([1.5.0](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.0)), and 1.5.2 denies some requests in headless `-p` runs that use `--dangerously-skip-permissions` ([1.5.2](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.2)).
themes.so_what: scripts that trust exit 0 or the raw output should check these signals now, and skip-permission jobs may be denied more often.

themes.title: Subagent effort, /loop and Mac shortcut defaults moved
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.317 makes subagents on a different model use that model's effort level, not the session's ([2.1.317](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.317)). Claude Code 2.1.319 ends self-paced `/loop` when a turn finishes without rescheduling ([2.1.319](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.319)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.2 makes macOS Option-key shortcuts work by default, reversible with `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` ([1.5.2](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.2)).
themes.so_what: a subagent, a loop or a Mac terminal may behave differently than last week, so re-check any pinned setting.

watch_next: Check that scheduled `claude -p` and `agy -p` jobs still pass with Claude Code 2.1.319 and Antigravity CLI 1.5.3, since refused runs may now exit non-zero and skip-permission runs may be denied.
